  • Method Details

    • time

      public Caption.Builder time(LocalDate day)
      The day this caption is about, written for machines beside the text written for people: meta("12 March 2026").time(LocalDate.of(2026, 3, 12)) prints <time datetime="2026-03-12">12 March 2026</time>. The text stays yours — its language, its format, its wording; the attribute is what a search engine and a reader for the blind understand.

    • time

      public Caption.Builder time(Instant moment)
      The moment this caption is about, in UTC and as precise as the instant given — for a publication, an edit, an event. Calling either time after the other keeps the last.

    • lang

      public Caption.Builder lang(String languageTag)
      Language of this text when it differs from the page: a Latin name in a Russian catalogue, a quotation, a brand written the way its own country writes it. A screen reader pronounces it accordingly instead of reading it as broken page language.
